notes: Original research article (Int J Hydrogen Energy 38 (2013) 10453-10460); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Seven KOH-activated anthracite carbons (3 raw, 4 urea N-doped) measured gravimetrically (VTI) at 77 and 298 K up to 8 MPa, with excess isotherms also from a volumetric HPVA-II. Literature data (refs 7-9, 23, 24, 28-30, 50) are plotted alongside in Figs. 6-8, but the paper presents the 7 ACs as new ('the 7ACs reported in this study'); no statement that its own uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Quotes render the text-layer glyphs '¼' and 'e' as '=' and en dash, checked against page images main-2.png and main-6.png.
